name: plugin-phone-control
description: Track and control local Codex sessions and Chrome tabs from a paired phone.

interface.shortDescription: Follow local Codex work from your phone.
interface.longDescription: A local-first task dashboard for Codex Desktop and CLI sessions. Receive opt-in Web Push alerts, answer request_user_input, safely resume or steer turns, explicitly transfer verified desktop-app sessions between phone and computer, and use the optional loopback-only Chrome bridge to control ordinary web tabs from a paired phone.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to start the Phone Control dashboard.
Check whether Phone Control can see this Codex session.
Explain the Phone Control security model.
